cells.gaps: No source found says the National Statistics Council met, or dates a rule, standard, calendar or penalty under the law, in the last three years. A March 2025 reply says the council set up working committees, one reviewing the 1994 texts; it does not say the council itself met.
cells.note: Legislative Decree 94-01 is in force and Executive Decree 95-159 was made under it, so stage 4. The council's working committees of 2025 do not plainly show the council appointed or meeting, so not 5.
